extra_prose: extract first balanced JSON object; non-whitespace outside it sets extra_prose=true (recorded and reported per arm x B, not a failure by itself)
parse_failure: no balanced JSON object, cap-truncated unbalanced object, or schema-validation failure (missing/extra fields, wrong types, empty answer) -> unparseable
malformed_scoring: unparseable scores as wrong for the arm that produced it, and feeds a reported malformed-rate per arm x B
